mapper.select: SELECT p.id FROM content_post p WHERE (p.slug = #{slug} OR CONCAT('post-', p.id) = #{slug}) AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.publish_status = 1 AND p.visibility = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_comment ( post_id, user_id, parent_id, root_id, content, status, like_count, deleted ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{rootId}, #{content}, 1, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE content_post SET comment_count = CASE WHEN comment_count > 0 THEN comment_count - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.root_id AS rootId, c.content AS content, c.like_count AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, IFNULL(u.nickname, '') AS nickname FROM content_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE content_comment SET deleted = 1, status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
